decks.name: LeetCode #424 - Longest Repeating Character Replacement
decks.description: Find the length of the longest substring with same characters after replacing at most k characters

cards.question: Longest Repeating Character Replacement: You are given a string s and an integer k. You can choose any character of the string and change it to any other uppercase English character. You can perform this operation at most k times. Return the length of the longest substring containing the same letter you can get after performing the above operations.

solutions.name: Sliding Window (Optimal)
solutions.explanation: Use a sliding window with a hash map to track character frequencies. Track the maximum frequency of any character in the current window. If window size minus max frequency exceeds k, shrink from left. The key insight is we don't need to update maxf when shrinking - we only care about finding a larger window.

solutions.name: Sliding Window
solutions.explanation: For each unique character, use a sliding window to find the longest substring where we can replace other characters to make them all the same. Try each character separately and track the maximum length across all characters.

solutions.explanation: Try all possible substrings. For each substring, count character frequencies and check if we can make it valid by replacing at most k characters. Track the maximum length found. Inefficient with O(n²) time complexity.
